events.title: 크리스털 팰리스 sign 21-year-old striker Chris Armstrong from 밀월 for £1 million.

애스턴 빌라 pay a club record £2.5 million for 리버풀 striker Dean Saunders . Dion Dublin breaks his leg in 맨체스터 유나이티드's 1–0 home win over 크리스털 팰리스 , and is expected to be out of action until early spring. 첼시 travel to Villa Park and beat 애스턴 빌라 3–1.

An exciting set of Premier League fixtures includes a 1–0 home win for 노리치 시티 over 사우샘프턴, which maintains their lead of the table. 노팅엄 포리스트 are bottom of the table after a 4–1 defeat to 블랙번 로버스 at Ewood Park . 맨체스터 시티 beat 셰필드 웬즈데이 3–0 at Hillsborough. 윔블던 record their first win of the season with a 3–2 victory over 아스널 at Selhurst Park . Charlton remain top of Division One with a 2–0 win over 선덜랜드 at Roker Park . 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 take their winning start to the season to five successive victories with a 2–1 away win over 브리스틀 로버스. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 are third after a 4–3 win over Peterborough.

헤리퍼드 유나이티드 have a Football League record four players sent off in a 1–1 Division Three draw with 노샘프턴 타운 at the County Ground . 맨체스터 유나이티드 make it four consecutive Premier League victories by beating Leeds 2–0 at Old Trafford. Division One promotion favourites 더비 카운티 are currently bottom of the table with one point from their first five games, having lost 4–3 at home to 브리스틀 시티.
Dick Advocaat makes his debut as the manager of Dutch national team , as the successor of Rinus Michels , with a 2–3 friendly defeat against Italy in Eindhoven .
Vinnie Jones returns to 윔블던 after three years away in a £700,000 move from 첼시.
Dean Saunders signs for 애스턴 빌라 from 리버풀, for a transfer fee of £2.3 million.

노리치 시티 maintain their lead of the Premier League with a 3–2 win over 첼시 at Stamford Bridge . 맨체스터 유나이티드 have climbed to third after beating 에버턴 2–0 at Goodison Park to make it five league wins in succession. 크리스털 팰리스 are still looking for a first Premier League after being held to a 2–2 draw at home to Oldham, although 노팅엄 포리스트 are still bottom after losing 2–1 at home to 셰필드 웬즈데이. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 go top of Division One with a sixth successive victory, beating 포츠머스 3–1 on Tyneside .

All 22 Division Three clubs receive £10,000 compensation each from the Football League to cover the loss of gate revenue brought upon by the recent demise of 올더숏 and Maidstone United. 블랙번 로버스 miss the chance to go top of the Premier League by losing 3–2 at home to 에버턴. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 boost their chances of an immediate return to the top flight by beating 브리스틀 시티 5–1 at Ashton Gate.

더비 카운티 pay the record fee for a club outside the top division – and a national record for a defender – when they sign 노츠 카운티 centre-back Craig Short in a £2.5 million deal. In the Premier League, 블랙번 로버스' unbeaten start comes to an end when 에버턴 beat them 3–2 at Ewood Park , with Tony Cottee scoring twice.

At Villa Park , home debutant Dean Saunders sinks his former club, bagging two in a 4–2 win over a depleted 리버풀 side. Meanwhile, 윔블던's 1–1 draw with 블랙번 로버스 ends with three players sent off: Tony Dobson and Mike Newell for Rovers and Vinnie Jones on his second debut for the Dons. Elsewhere in London, QPR and 미들즈브러 drew 3–3 after a late 레인저스 penalty converted by Andy Sinton . Post-match, Boro boss Lennie Lawrence announces the cancellation of a move to sign Robert Lee , owing to the player's unwillingness to commit to a move away from the capital and the involvement of another club. 노리치 시티 are still top of the Premier League thanks to a 1–0 home win over 셰필드 웬즈데이. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 extend their winning start to the Division One campaign to seven games, beating 브리스틀 시티 5–0. 밀월 break into the playoff zone with a 6–0 home win over 노츠 카운티.
Division One leaders 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 sign 찰턴 애슬레틱 midfielder Robert Lee for £700,000.

Alan Shearer scored his tenth Premier League goal for 블랙번 로버스 in his tenth appearance in a 2–0 defeat of 올덤 애슬레틱 at Ewood Park, although 노리치 시티 are still top of the table after a 1–1 draw at Coventry, who occupy third place. Division One leaders 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 have now won eight successive games, their latest triumph being by a single goal over Peterborough at London Road . Charlton are still second with a 2–0 home win over Swindon, while 더비 카운티 finally win a league game at the eighth attempt, beating 사우스엔드 유나이티드 2–0 at the Baseball Ground .

울버햄프턴 원더러스, third in Division One, strengthen their promotion push with a 4–0 away win over local rivals 버밍엄 시티, with striker Darren Roberts scoring a hat-trick on his league debut following his recent move from non-league 버턴 앨비언 . Birmingham are sixth in the league the season after their promotion, although they have picked up just one point from their last four games after starting with four successive victories.
프레스턴 노스 엔드 's Les Chapman and 칼라일 유나이티드 's Aidan McCaffrey become the first managerial casualties of the season.
맨체스터 유나이티드 are eliminated from the UEFA Cup on penalties after two goalless draws in their first round contest with Torpedo Moscow .

The month ends with 노리치 시티 topping the Premier League, with 블랙번 로버스 in second place, 코번트리 시티 third and 맨체스터 유나이티드 fourth. 브라이언 클러프 's 노팅엄 포리스트 prop up the top flight with just one win from their opening nine games. 크리스털 팰리스, who finished third in the league two seasons ago, lie in second from bottom place. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 lead Division One with a 100% record in the league stretching eight games, with 찰턴 애슬레틱 occupying second place without any defeats from their opening nine games. 울버햄프턴 원더러스, 레스터 시티, 버밍엄 시티 (in the hunt for a second successive promotion) and 밀월 occupy the playoff zone. 더비 카운티, who began the season as most people's favourites for the Division One title, are third from bottom in the table, only a point ahead of 브리스틀 로버스 and 반즐리.
